analysis: Static disassembly of MAP-named original PE methods and original DFM resources; existing level converter original-instruction evidence is referenced separately.
method_hash_boundary: Original PE bytes from each resolved MAP symbol through the next distinct MAP symbol; may include trailing literal data and alignment. Addresses are virtual addresses, not MAP segment offsets.
firmware_admission: 1.0.00..1.2.99; catalogue/specification intersection retained from the existing IOPE source review. Native runs establish only their specifically observed revisions.

controls.scope: Every existing relay threshold or dimmer minimum
Enabled only while at least one existing relay checkbox is selected

control_sequence: ascending channel number: minimum percentage, maximum percentage, restrike
facts: LoadOutputs at 0x12d8535..0x12d858a admits maximum only for zero-based channel index >1 and reads the maximum array at channel index-2.
SaveOutputs at 0x12dd5bf skips maximum append for zero-based channel indices <=1; other active channels append in channel order.
SetCBusUnit sets the initialization flag while binding controls. For relay channels it hides and unbinds maximum; for dimmers it binds maximum.
Turn On DFM binds both sliders to percentage interpretation (UseRawValues=False), maximum 100 and default minimum zero.

trkMinPropertiesChange compares displayed maximum <= displayed minimum outside initialization and moves the inverse maximum position down one; the paired percentage is minimum+1 with trackbar endpoint clipping.

trkMaxPropertiesChange compares displayed minimum >= displayed maximum outside initialization and moves the inverse minimum position up one; the paired percentage is maximum-1 with trackbar endpoint clipping.
The uncrossed maximum branch at 0x11933cf jumps to 0x11934d1, skipping neighbor position and Changed writes; a noncanonical raw minimum is preserved.
Restrike delay DFM binds UseRawValues=True, minimum1 and maximum254. FormatTimeShort formats raw*10 seconds below6, or raw//6 minutes and (raw%6)*10 seconds.
Restrike delay enablement scans existing IsRelayChannel rows and selected checkboxes; dimmer rows are hidden. Inactive/dimmer raw bits do not enable the control.

preservation_contract.rule: Only explicit controls and paired slider cascades may change values; retain unselected and inactive array elements, unsupported stored bits, and unrelated parameters.

limits: No original GUI, VCL interaction, lamp behavior, physical controller, network write or power-cycle acceptance.
No Output Logic association/function/recovery controls or output group assignment.

No whole-dialog SaveOutputs/BeforeSaveProgrammingInformation; unrelated output recovery, inactive-slot canonicalization, scenes, input blocks, join/corridor state, LightStateMachine and potentiometer expiry rewrites are not claimed.
Raw minimum/maximum setters are not admitted; selections are percentages with documented minimum-then-maximum order.
Native database save/reload evidence belongs to its separate receipt; the editor itself stages and verifies but does not save.
